decision: Store the tester switch as the browser entry prisma-prim.interface, set or cleared by the interface=clarte or interface=current URL parameter applied once at the root and then removed
why: The choice must survive navigation, reload and sign-in without a server change, and leaving Clarte must not be undone by a stale parameter

decision: App renders ClarteFrame or the current shell from one section composition; a section may carry clarteContent and clarte-entries.ts picks each tab's renderer
why: Eighteen slices replace one tab each without touching the frame or another slice's tab, and App keeps every gate, key and callback

decision: Move the ApplicationSection contract and the focus-owning section list from ApplicationShell.tsx to production-shell/application-section.ts
why: Clarte must not depend on a module that imports Prisme components or styles; the current shell re-exports the type unchanged
evidence: Issue #1530 visual language; existing ApplicationShell and App tests

decision: Copy DM Sans and Manrope byte for byte to public/clarte/fonts under the families Clarte DM Sans and Clarte Manrope
why: Reusing the family names would let the Clarte faces replace the Prisme font requests of the current interface
evidence: SHA-256 match with public/prisme/fonts and the Google Fonts provenance in apps/web/src/clarte/README.md
